vocabulary.definition: the non-living components of an ecosystem.

the amount of each wavelength of light absorbed by chlorophyll.

the wavelengths of light that bring about photosynthesis.
energy required by a substrate molecule before it can undergo a chemical change.

selfless concern for the well-being of others.
